title: b7z9.47-style decision: solicited unicast-DIO receive contract (DIS -> unicast DIO admission)
description: OPEN DECISION surfaced by worker6-8rm3 reconciliation (spec 09 13.3 R-09-005 gate landed by worker6-dqeg/i8cd). Status quo: the admission gate admits ONLY canonical multicast DIOs (dst ff02::1a, Rule 255, hop 255) matching Python authenticated_dio.py; but BOTH stacks implement the DIS sender side (Python dis.py DisAction.UNICAST_DIO_WITH_CONFIGURATION per RFC 6550 8.3; Rust receive.rs send_dio(source)) producing unicast-destination DIOs that no receiver can admit — the receive contract for solicited unicast DIOs is unimplemented in both. Two options: (A) multicast-only DIO delivery — production send_dio(addr) targets become multicast, DIS responses suppressed or re-targeted multicast (deviates from RFC 6550 8.3 unicast-response SHOULD; simplest, gate unchanged); (B) bounded authenticated solicited-unicast-DIO admission — admit unicast-dst DIOs iff dst == own link-local AND hop 255 AND Rule 255 AND link-authenticated AND replay-fresh AND a matching authenticated DIS was admitted from that peer within a bounded window (needs a solicitation ledger); requires the Python mirror for parity and spec 09 text. Two lichen-node tests are blocked on this decision (multicast_dio_and_dis_are_received:1099 unicast-DIS-response expectation; three_rpl_stacks join chain using root.send_dio(relay_addr)/relay.send_dio(leaf_addr) unicast DIOs) — currently red, left red deliberately (not skipped) pending the decision. Related: worker6-dqeg worker6-i8cd worker6-cpbe.
close_reason: DECISION RESOLVED: option (A) — multicast-only DIO delivery. Implemented on beads-worker-7 (commit f447662504): rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/receive.rs solicited DIS response now re-targets send_dio(RPL_ALL_NODES) (ff02::1a) instead of the un-admittable unicast destination, with the contract rationale documented in-code (R-09-005 admission gate + Python parity + RFC 6550 8.3 SHOULD override). Consensus basis: worker-3 (already implemented option A on fix-dio-unicast-dis-0l4q, commit e2adf9f3cf), worker-4 synthesis (Python's UNICAST_DIO_WITH_CONFIGURATION has zero production callers — Rust receive.rs:578 was the lone divergent caller), worker-6 recommendation (parity discipline; RFC SHOULD not MUST; (B) needs ledger + Python mirror + spec text). Effect: multicast_dio_and_dis_are_received now passes (was red since the admission gate landed); suite 293 passed / 1 failed (down from 291/2 at round start). Remaining failure: three_rpl_stacks leaf-announce relay chain — fixture reconciliation filed as worker6-c0sv (do NOT weaken assertions). If bounded solicited-unicast admission (option B) is wanted later, file as a feature epic per worker-3's suggestion (solicitation ledger + Python mirror + spec 09 text; ledger design must address the 5byi scope-mismatch hazard).
